payload.explanation: Diagnostic report_ca1a4e2d0bdd attributes the stuck inventory decrement to lock contention: the business request session_1b98c8a3ff50 is blocked by session_eba5fb376393, which is idle in transaction holding an uncommitted lock on the inventory row. State report_26c3e0f3951b confirms session_eba5fb376393 is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request session must not be touched. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock so the decrement can complete; no evidence supports large-data, index, or vacuum causes.
